## ea2b82cf172e

**A2 — reproduced exact-control defects; A3 — opt-in degenerate semantic
mismatch.** Audited generator SHA-256:
`1daedd70220cb0f534e2b923810f41f43ed7ad21b1b0c3e0a315a2c2f260f285`.
Executed canonical RULE_HASH: `308928f64b36`.

**Default baseline:** three bands, paired `seed=52000+i, sample_index=i`,
i=0..19: 60/60 generated inputs accepted by its validator. This is not a
Racket-output census and is not a claim that every ordinary sample is correct.

**A2 controls:** seed 17/index 0 yields these exact results:

| Band / override | Observed behavior | Contract problem |
|---|---|---|
| medium / `grid_h=10` | ValueError: outside [12,20] | Advertised domain is 10..25 |
| medium / `grid_h=25` | ValueError: outside [12,20] | Same legal endpoint rejected |
| medium / `n_objects=1` | ValueError: outside [2,7] | Advertised domain is 1..9 |
| medium / `n_objects=9` | ValueError: outside [2,7] | Same legal endpoint rejected |
| easy / `texture="not_a_texture"` | Returns 14x13, validator accepts | Invalid named control silently falls through |
| medium / `unknown_axis=3` | Returns 16x18, validator accepts | Unknown override ignored |

The difficulty-conditioned default intervals have leaked into legal override
validation; the task does not declare those endpoints incompatible. Use the
full advertised domain for exact overrides, and a narrower distribution only
for unoverridden draws. Reject unknown keys and enum values. All errors and
sample plans are in `checks/audit/ea2b82cf172e/probe.json`. **No fix included.**

**A3 connectivity:** the advertised caller-opt-in degenerate
`texture="touching_objects"`, seed 17/index 0/easy, produces two adjacent 3x3
rectangles, colors 8 and 9. A color-blind nonzero flood fill counts one connected
component and predicts `[[8]]`. The actual Racket object operation separates
same-color objects and returns `[[8,0],[0,8]]`, representing two objects.

The target validator explicitly rejects this multicolor connected component:
`object component 0 contains multiple colors [8, 9]`. It is an ARC-shaped input
that this generator deliberately emits through an opt-in degenerate path, not
an ordinary strict-domain example. The audit therefore identifies a mismatch
between the degenerate texture's merging rationale/color-blind diagnostic and
Racket semantics, **not a demonstrated ordinary training-label error**.

Full input, actual Racket output, rival output, source hashes, overrides and
validator result are in `checks/audit/ea2b82cf172e/counterexample.json`.

```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply ea2b82cf172e --input ../checks/audit/ea2b82cf172e/input.json --out ../checks/audit/ea2b82cf172e/racket.json
```

Packet-root command, exit 0; actual effective cwd and source hashes are recorded
by the CLI. A future repair should either revise the description/diagnostic or
make the touching rectangles the same color when it specifically intends one
merged Racket object. **Patch status: audit only.**
